subject.title: fix: deliver background task completions through owning sessions

question: Should this PR wait for live Telegram owner-session delivery proof, or may maintainers accept the remaining source-only proof risk?
rationale: The code path is source-reproducible, but automation cannot prove the user-visible Telegram topic/session delivery behavior without live proof or an explicit maintainer override.

options.title: Require Live Delivery Proof
options.body: Wait for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

options.title: Accept Source-Only Risk
options.body: Merge with source and regression-test evidence only, while maintainers own the risk that real transport/session delivery can still misroute or drop the completion.

options.title: Pause For Broader Delivery Contract
options.body: Hold this patch if maintainers want one canonical task-completion wake contract across background-task, ACP, exec, and subagent paths first.

recommendation.title: Require Live Delivery Proof
recommendation.body: Wait for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest recent current-main history across the affected subagent completion and task delivery paths.
